newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian c.bank sells HRK 98 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatian c.bank sells HRK 98 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 97.8 million kuna worth of 35- and 91-day liquidity bills at an auction on Wednesday.

Volume shrank from 281 million kuna issued a week ago after commercial banks, which bid for bills, on Tuesday repaid some 126 million kuna granted them by the central bank through a repurchase deal last week.
But 35- and 91-day rates were stuck at 7.50 and 9.0 percent, respectively for the ninth week running.

Monday's reserve payment drained 3.7 billion kuna from the banking sector, compared to 3.3 billion under a previous fortnightly requirement, an official told Reuters. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
